description: Call any public operation of the coordination API by its /v1 name (GET /v1/ops/search finds the one you need; GET /v1/openapi.json lists them all). Path parameters are filled from params by name (:protocol → params.protocol); the rest become the query string, or the JSON body for a POST. Pass api_key for keyed operations.

api_key.description: your tfr_ key, for keyed operations (keyless reads need none)

body.description: the JSON body of a POST

params.description: path and query parameters by name

name: taifoon_op
